IdeoPresetDef.label: sword pavilion
IdeoPresetDef.description: Discipline, hierarchy and the sword. Every disciple has a rank and a duty, and the strong lead the weak.

IdeoPresetDef.label: silent lotus temple
IdeoPresetDef.description: A community of healers who hold everything in common and give up desire.

IdeoPresetDef.label: heavenly cauldron pavilion
IdeoPresetDef.description: Every person is an alchemist of their own life, and everything has a price that can be refined into a pill.

IdeoPresetDef.label: ancient dragon clan
IdeoPresetDef.description: Pure blood, ancient pride and a debt to the ancestors. Bloodlines are guarded like treasure.

IdeoPresetDef.label: blood moon cult
IdeoPresetDef.description: The Heavens are a cage and power is the only key. The righteous call it demonic; it works.

IdeoPresetDef.label: wandering path
IdeoPresetDef.description: No hall, no master, no walls: the road is the sect. Everyone cultivates where they stand.

IdeoPresetDef.label: body way
IdeoPresetDef.description: The body is the first temple; tempering it is the first duty. Those who hold the line with their bare hands are respected above all.

IdeoPresetDef.label: puppet path
IdeoPresetDef.description: Patience, threads and wood. A disciple of the Valley of a Thousand Strings never fights alone.

IdeoPresetDef.label: thunder way
IdeoPresetDef.description: Seek the tribulation, bear it and be reborn. A disciple who has not stood under the lightning is still a child.
